policy.duplicate_rule: A claimed responsibility belongs to its catalog capability even while inactive. Extend, activate, or explicitly supersede that capability instead of creating an independent implementation.

capabilities.purpose: Generate a reviewable Python architecture inventory, dependency graph, AST-span LOC metrics, and drift check.
consider_when: The Python package has enough modules that ownership or dependency direction is difficult to inspect manually.
Architecture documentation is drifting from code.
LOC, module skew, or dependency evidence would materially improve a refactor decision.
activate_when: The owner accepts the generated-artifact boundary and names the Python source roots to analyze.

capabilities.purpose: Document workload-specific time and space complexity for important execution paths without pretending a generic static score proves runtime behavior.
consider_when: A pipeline is producing enough data that asymptotic or memory behavior affects feasibility.
A performance decision needs an explicit workload and algorithm model.
activate_when: Representative workloads and the critical algorithms are known well enough to support a reviewable analysis.
activation_requires: Named workload assumptions and measured evidence where available.

capabilities.purpose: Turn observed product failures and known-bad examples into a small deterministic challenge corpus once product outputs exist.
consider_when: The product emits results with stable correctness criteria.
A real escaped defect or representative known-bad case can be replayed deterministically.
activate_when: At least one product result and its oracle are stable enough to preserve without synthetic test inflation.
activation_requires: A bounded oracle and retention rule.
Focused checks tied to real product behavior.

capabilities.purpose: Persist reviewable chat, artifact, directive, and retrieval records behind explicit contracts and writeback boundaries.
consider_when: Project continuity cannot be maintained reliably through checked-in specifications and handoffs alone.
Chat, artifacts, or directives need durable retrieval with provenance.
activate_when: The project has a concrete memory consumer, retention policy, authority model, and inspectable writeback contract.
activation_requires: Data classification, retention, deletion, and provenance decisions.
A demonstrated consumer that cannot be served by repository artifacts alone.

capabilities.purpose: Queue reviewable reflection work such as session compaction, directive extraction, preference promotion, and link repair without silently changing project policy.
consider_when: Durable memory exists and repeated observations need deliberate review or promotion.
Automated summarization risks turning an observation into an unreviewed directive.
activate_when: Durable project memory is active and promotion decisions have a named reviewer and audit trail.
activation_requires: Review and rollback rules for promoted knowledge.

capabilities.purpose: Preserve append-oriented source assertions, provenance, challenges, and deterministic resolution instead of overwriting evidence with a canonical projection.
consider_when: Multiple sources can support, contradict, revise, or challenge a derived result.
A canonical answer must remain traceable to preserved assertions.
activate_when: The domain has explicit assertion, evidence, challenge, and resolution semantics.

capabilities.purpose: Keep domain and application semantics independent of frameworks while one visible composition root wires ports to concrete adapters.
consider_when: The same use cases will be exposed through more than one interface.
Database, model, search, or transport implementations should remain replaceable.
activate_when: The first application use case and its required ports are known.
activation_requires: Constructor injection without a service locator or import-time global wiring.

capabilities.purpose: Expose application use cases through a thin command-line adapter that shares typed inputs and results with later interfaces.
consider_when: A local deterministic interface is the fastest useful product boundary.
activate_when: At least one application use case has a stable typed input and result.

capabilities.purpose: Expose existing application use cases through a thin HTTP adapter without moving semantics into the web framework.
consider_when: A network client needs a use case already proven through the CLI.
activate_when: The CLI-backed application result contract is stable and an HTTP consumer is identified.
activation_requires: An HTTP contract and end-to-end acceptance check.

capabilities.purpose: Expose proven application use cases as MCP tools or resources while preserving the common application layer and its authority boundaries.
consider_when: An external agent needs a stable application capability rather than direct database or model access.
activate_when: The underlying use case is proven and an MCP consumer, tool contract, and authority boundary are explicit.
activation_requires: A versioned MCP contract and end-to-end client check.

capabilities.purpose: Add a small web interface over proven application use cases without creating an independent domain implementation.
consider_when: Users need interactive inspection after the CLI and shared result contracts are stable.
activate_when: A specific user workflow cannot be served adequately by the CLI or API alone.
activation_requires: A bounded workflow and browser-level acceptance check.

capabilities.purpose: Keep effective time, publication time, receipt time, source identity, checksum, and revision ancestry distinct so replay cannot introduce look-ahead.
consider_when: Sources arrive asynchronously, can be corrected, or are evaluated as of historical cutoffs.
A later result must prove exactly which source version was available.
activate_when: The domain has mutable or revised sources and an explicit as-of query or replay requirement.

capabilities.purpose: Split genuinely independent domain analysis across bounded roles with structured artifacts and independent approval where correlated error matters.
consider_when: Three or more domain lanes can proceed independently and produce mergeable artifacts.
The author of an evaluation should not approve the resulting risk decision.
activate_when: Parallel ownership materially shortens a real workflow and each lane has a disjoint write or artifact boundary.
activation_requires: Named roles, disjoint ownership, handoff schema, and stop conditions.
A demonstrated workload that benefits from parallelism.
